definition.def: A trend is a change or development towards something new or different.
To set a trend means to do something that becomes accepted or fashionable, and that a lot of other people copy.
examples: The record has already proved a success and may well start a trend.

definition.def: If something such as a topic or name is trending, a lot of people are discussing or mentioning it on social media.
examples: Minutes after the announcement, Heidi was trending on Twitter. [VERB]
The hashtag #RoyalBaby became the world's number 1 trending topic. [VERB-ing]

definition.def: If something is off trend it is not fashionable.
examples: I'm always bang off trend without having to work at it at all.
You're so off-trend I'm embarrassed for you.

definition.def: If something is on trend it is fashionable.
examples: The proposed new name is on trend with today's marketplace.
With florals a big hit this season, her look is bang on trend.
